explanation: Compared against OEIS A237348 (Sun): for each d ≥ 1 there is a positive integer N(d) such that every n > N(d) is k + m (k, m > 0) with prime(k) + 2d and prime(prime(m)) + 2d both prime. The Lean statement uses 1-indexed primes via Nat.nth Nat.Prime (j − 1), so prime(prime(m)) = nth Prime (nth Prime (m−1) − 1), and asks ∃ N > 0 with the property for all n > N. Faithful.
